Message.Name: Warehouse Stock Movement Message
Message.Description: Provides stock movement data from LME approved warehouses by product, grade, stock status and location in tonnes. Stock figures for one location, or port, are the aggregate of all the stocks in all the warehouses in that one location.

Field.Name: ReportDate
Field.Description: The business date for which the stock movement is being reported, as YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: ReportLevel
Field.Description: Indicates the level at which the stock movement quantity is being reported.

Field.Name: RemainingRecords
Field.Description: Number of remaining records to be published for a product. When the value of RemainingRecords equals RecordCount this is the last message for the report level.

Field.Name: RecordCount
Field.Description: Number of repeating records in this message.

Field.Name: Stock Records
Field.Description: The warehouse stock movement records carried by this message, counted by RecordCount.
